page.overview:
Who is Candelle?

Candelle was the queen of Esperia, the wife of King Reuven, and the mother of princess Shuri. Before, she served as captain of the kingdom's Battle Convoy.

She died 62 years ago due to a strange smog appearing in Esperia.

Candelle was a youthful-looking woman with light, free-flowing hair. She was considered attractive by men and women alike. Rather than the more formal clothing donned by other queens, she instead wore an outfit similar to that of a royal guard. It featured a light coat, frilled shirt, wrist cuffs, dark gloves, rolled up shorts, and a great coat with epaulettes hung over her shoulders. Additionally, she carried her sword on her person.

Befitting her status as a queen, Candelle was someone who enjoyed luxurious pleasures, such as the opera. Even before she was queen, she took her status very seriously, focusing on class and etiquette, and ensuring her subordinates did the same. She found Brook's habit of asking women to show him their panties irritating; when Brook asked Candelle to do the same, she hit him, declaring his lack of manners and saying she would teach him a lesson with blows.
